name: Mori Oku no Kyoushuujo ~Goshujin to Yume no Love Love Ecchi~
original_name: 森奥の教習所～ご主人と夢のらぶらぶえっち～
source:
A story about pets that become demi-human as the result of their deep love for their masters and a young girl who happens upon them in search of her dog.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE237605.html]DLsite English[/url]]
